edges.reason: constructor parameter _factory flows into UniswapV2Library.pairFor to derive the pair.
constructor parameter _tokenA flows into pair derivation and token checks.
constructor parameter _tokenB flows into pair derivation and token checks.
constructor parameter _period is forwarded to Epoch which stores it in the period state variable.
constructor parameter _startTime is forwarded to Epoch which stores it in startTime.
constructor writes the resolved pair address into the pair state variable.
constructor sets token0 from _pair.token0().
constructor sets token1 from _pair.token1().
constructor initializes blockTimestampLast from the pair reserves.
constructor initializes price0CumulativeLast from the pair.
constructor initializes price1CumulativeLast from the pair.
checkEpoch compares now against nextEpochPoint() to gate execution.
checkEpoch and checkStartTime depend on the miner-influenceable block timestamp for access gating.
checkEpoch modifier controls whether update() body executes and increments epoch.
setPeriod is protected by onlyOperator which compares msg.sender against the stored operator.
update() reads the pair state variable to query cumulative prices.
update() performs external calls into the Uniswap pair contract, allowing control transfer to an untrusted contract before state updates.
update() receives the current block timestamp returned by UniswapV2OracleLibrary.currentCumulativePrices.
timeElapsed is computed as blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast using wrapping uint32 subtraction.
current blockTimestamp is the minuend of the timeElapsed subtraction.
timeElapsed is the divisor in the average price computation; zero is early-returned but timestamp manipulation still affects the result.
price0Cumulative is the minuend of the subtraction feeding the price0Average division.
price1Cumulative is the minuend of the subtraction feeding the price1Average division.
stored price0CumulativeLast is subtracted from the current cumulative price.
update() assigns the returned cumulative price to the price0Cumulative local variable.
update() assigns the returned cumulative price to the price1Cumulative local variable.
the computed average is stored into the price0Average state variable.
the computed average is stored into the price1Average state variable.
update() feeds the cumulative delta into the uint224 cast of the uq112x112 average.
the result of the rounded division is truncated by the uint224 cast.
update() writes the new cumulative price back to price0CumulativeLast.
update() writes the new cumulative price back to price1CumulativeLast.
update() writes the new block timestamp back to blockTimestampLast.
the token parameter is compared against token0/token1 to choose the price average branch.
amountIn is multiplied by the selected average price in consult().
consult() assigns the decoded multiplication result to amountOut.
price0Average is read and multiplied when the queried token equals token0.
price1Average is read and multiplied when the queried token equals token1.
token0 determines which branch of the if/else executes in consult().
token1 is the expected value in the else branch require of consult().
